hellofresh.title_primary: HelloFresh Gift Card: How to Buy, Redeem & Official Terms
hellofresh.meta_description: Direct official facts on HelloFresh gift cards: where to buy e-gift cards, redemption steps, subscription card requirements, and non-combinable promo rules.

quick_answers.question: Can you buy official HelloFresh gift cards?
quick_answers.answer: Yes. HelloFresh sells digital e-gift cards directly on its website in custom or preset amounts.

quick_answers.question: Where and how do you redeem a HelloFresh gift card?
quick_answers.answer: Redeem directly at hellofresh.com/gift/redeem by entering your credit code. An active or newly created account is required.

quick_answers.question: Do you need a credit card to redeem a gift card?
quick_answers.answer: Yes. HelloFresh is a recurring meal kit subscription. A valid credit card / payment method is required to activate an account even when using a gift card.
quick_answers.source_label: HelloFresh Terms & Conditions — Section 11 (Gift Cards & Vouchers)

quick_answers.question: Can gift cards be combined with promo codes (e.g. 16 free meals)?
quick_answers.answer: No. Official HelloFresh terms state gift cards cannot be combined with promotional discounts, referral credits, or coupon codes.

quick_answers.question: Do HelloFresh gift cards expire or lose value over time?
quick_answers.answer: No. Gift cards have no expiration date and incur no inactivity or dormancy fees.

quick_answers.question: Can existing subscribers redeem a gift card on their weekly deliveries?
quick_answers.answer: Existing subscribers must order a separate single box or contact Customer Care to apply credit, as recurring weekly auto-renewals do not automatically pull from gift balances.
quick_answers.source_label: HelloFresh FAQ — Gift Card Redemption for Existing Customers

quick_answers.question: Are physical gift cards available in retail stores (Target / Walmart)?
quick_answers.answer: Unconfirmed. In-store retail availability is subject to local store inventory and is not tracked live on the HelloFresh website.

steps_to_redeem.step: 1. Navigate to the official redemption page at hellofresh.com/gift/redeem.
2. Sign in to your HelloFresh account, or register a new account if you are a first-time customer.
3. Enter the alphanumeric gift card code received via email and submit.
4. Select your preferred meal plan preferences and add a backup payment method to finalize box scheduling.

terms_summary.detail: Non-refundable and cannot be redeemed for cash, except where required by state law.
Valid only within the United States for orders on hellofresh.com.
Any unspent credit remains attached to your account profile for subsequent orders.
